headline: Made by Google 2026 live blog: Let’s watch Trevor Noah talk about the Pixel 11
summary: Get ready for the Made by Google keynote featuring the new Pixel hardware. Trevor Noah is hosting the celebrity-packed live show. Expect a potentially 'cringefest' broadcast based on last year's event.

headline: 8BitDo mechanical keyboard with extra keypad is 30 percent off
summary: Grab the 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard with Dual Super Buttons for $69.99. This deal offers one of the lowest prices for the retro-styled keyboard. Add a touch of vintage flair to your desk setup.

headline: Petlibro smart feeders outage leaves pets hungry
summary: A Petlibro outage is preventing smart pet feeders from dispensing food. Users report devices like feeders, litter boxes, and water fountains are offline. The company claims local settings *should* work, but users are experiencing issues.

headline: Kinetic Publishing unveils five ambitious indie games
summary: Kinetic Publishing, from the Phasmophobia team, held its first game showcase. Five new ambitious titles are set for release in 2027 and 2028. The publisher will also release the next game from the creator of Telling Lies.

headline: Dataminers find five potential DLC characters for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
summary: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is out, and dataminers are already digging into its files. They've discovered mentions of five interesting new heroes. These findings suggest future DLC characters for the fighting game.

headline: Warner Bros. confirms Hogwarts Legacy 2 is in development
summary: A sequel to the popular game Hogwarts Legacy has been officially confirmed. Warner Bros. announced that development is actively underway. Fans can look forward to more magical adventures in the Wizarding World.

headline: Get the Wolfbox MF60 Cordless Electric Air Duster for only $28
summary: The Wolfbox MF60 cordless electric air duster is on sale for $28. It offers powerful airflow for effective dust busting. This tool is essential for PC maintenance and cleaning electronics.

headline: Brandon Sanderson shares new insights into Tolkien's early life
summary: Brandon Sanderson revealed a rare Tolkien tidbit on his podcast. He found an unfamiliar illustration of Helm's Deep in an unexpected place. The find sheds light on Tolkien's life before The Lord of the Rings.

headline: Millions wowed by once-in-a-generation solar eclipse across UK and Europe
summary: A rare solar eclipse captivated millions across the UK and Europe. Over 95% of the Sun was obscured in Cornwall. Parts of Spain experienced the magic of a total eclipse.

headline: Watch: Solar eclipse captivates UK skies
summary: Millions witnessed a rare solar eclipse across the UK and Europe. The event was described as a once-in-a-generation spectacle. Video footage captured the stunning astronomical phenomenon.

headline: Russian grain terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
summary: Major Russian grain export terminals were struck in a Black Sea attack. Both Russia and Ukraine are targeting each other's shipping facilities. Grain exports from both nations are consequently declining.

headline: Students await A-level, T-level, and BTec results
summary: Students are eagerly awaiting their A-level, T-level, and BTec results. A record number of students are expected to secure university places. Many hope to get into their first-choice institutions.
